description: Create a task. Requires: name + (listId or listName). Use create_bulk_tasks for multiple. Supports subtasks via nested 'subtasks' array (preferred) or 'parent' ID. Supports custom_fields as [{id,value}], assignees as user IDs/emails/names.

items.description: User ID (as string), email, or username

custom_fields.description: Custom field values as JSON string: [{id, value}].

dueDate.description: Due date: unix ms or natural language.

listName.description: List name. Use if no listId.

parentListName.description: List name of parent task. Helps disambiguate parentName.

parentName.description: Parent task name. Resolved to ID if parent is missing.

priority.description: Priority 1 (urgent) - 4 (low), as string or number. Set only if requested.

startDate.description: Start date: unix ms or natural language.

subtasks.description: Draft subtasks to create with the task.

assignees.description: User IDs, emails, or usernames (comma-separated or JSON string)

custom_fields.description: Custom field values as JSON string: [{id, value}]

team_id.description: The ClickUp Team ID or Workspace Name to use. If provided, the server will switch to this workspace for this and subsequent requests in the current session.

time_estimate.description: Time estimate: natural language ('2h 30m', '45m', '1.5h'), or plain number (minutes).

name: create_task
